Born Elegant, Born to Captivate.

Crafted in a new design language, Luna embodies effortless elegance. Premium textile finishes soften its mechanical presence.

At a 160cm full-size humanoid form, Luna moves with natural poise and fluidity—captivating attention wherever it appears.

High Dynamics, Built to Perform.

Powered by the second-generation Sys 0 engine with upgraded joint motors, Luna delivers dynamic, fluid movement—ready for the real world.

Advanced Cooling, Extended Performance.

With upgraded thermal management, joint surfaces remain cool even during extended operation.

An enhanced battery management system significantly boosts endurance for prolonged performance.

Multi-Layer Protection, Peace of Mind.

From hardware redundancy to intelligent perception, Luna integrates a multi-layered safety architecture to safeguard every moment.

Synchronized Control, Spectacle Reimagined.

Intelligent swarm control synchronizes 200+ units with millisecond precision.

Unleashing stunning visual impact, with a single command.

Multi-Modal Interaction, Warmth in Every Exchange.

By integrating multimodal interaction, Luna responds with natural gestures during conversations, enabling more intuitive human-robot interaction.

Graceful Moves, Effortless to Teach.

AI-Powered Creation, Ideas Realized.

Featuring the industry's first AI task editor,

Luna enables scene creation through simple natural language input.

Simply describe your scenario, and AI composes dance, motion, visual, and voice into complete tasks.
